whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Certified Bawarchi,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.1★ reviews on AIIMS Rd in Phulwari Sharif, but your online ordering currently relies on a generic third-party menu link.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, special menu showcase, aur table reservation feature integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bawarchi

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Certified Bawarchi team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We noticed your strong 4.1-star presence near AIIMS Road, so we tailored the demo with direct WhatsApp food ordering and a clean mobile menu showcase. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur actual pricing integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
